title: SteelColumnConfiguration
description: SteelColumnConfiguration: Steel column required to support a given number of stories at a given floor height, including the intumescent paint applied for fire protection.

ColumnSection.description: Section of the column required for this configuration. SteelSection: Steel section to be used on Bars. Defined by a section profile.

FloorHeight.description: Floor-to-floor height that the column configuration is designed for. Property has a quantity of type Length measured in [m].

NumberOfStories.description: Number of stories supported by the column in this configuration.

IntumescentPaintThickness.description: Thickness of intumescent paint covering exposed steelwork. Allowance used for when computing takeoffs of the configuration. Property has a quantity of type Length measured in [m].

IntumescentPaintMaterial.description: Material of the intumescent paint. Used when computing material takeoffs of the configuration. Material: Physical material to be used for Takeoffs and asigned to Physical elements. Material is capable of storing discipline specific data in Properties.

_bhomVersion.description: Optional version of BHoM used as part of automatic versioning and schema upgrades.
